VAT where there is room; never a yearly price); agency figures only the sourced ranges, never in the same sentence or field as the word agency.
rules.note_premium: 3 Oct 2026: one premium static per concept added on top of the six cells (generated scene + Otto's real app screens + type set by hand; files in launch/2026-10/creatives/<market>/premium/, cells '<market>-aN-premium', 'premium' = the finished 1:1 + 9:16, never re-rendered from a template). Requested as a stronger feed layer; it lowers the video share to 18 of 42 (43 %), so min_video_share is set to 0.42 here on purpose (the 18 faceless videos stay). Put it back to 0.5 when the premium cells are dropped or get motion versions.

notes: Otto's own launch matrix for the Netherlands, October 2026 (launch 3 Oct; launch/2026-10/). English copy for Dutch small businesses: euro, 24-hour times (07:35), the report 'in English, Dutch or German: your choice'.
